alex: Quick sync — we need to triage the audit-ingest backfill + BYO key edge cases before we lock Q2 roadmap. Who's on this?

maria: I'm on. main ask from sales: customers want retention toggles + exportable signed evidence for audits (SOC2/ISO).

kevin: Ops note: backfilling large audit streams will spike ingest and indexing. We should define a throttled backfill job and a customer-priority queue.

alex: Agreed. Proposal: 1) backfill service with per-tenant rate limits, 2) export format v1 (gzipped JSONL with signature), 3) BYOK handshake that supports rotated keys.

diane: For BYOK the handshake needs to document key metadata + rotation windows. Legal wants proof of custody for exported evidence — ideally with HSM-backed signatures. @elaine-legal can you confirm requirements?

elaine-legal: We need deterministic signatures, time-bound attestations, and an audit trail for key wraps/unwraps. Export must include chain-of-custody metadata: who initiated, timestamp, key-id, kms-audit-id. Also need retention/hold toggles for legal holds.

sam: UX question — how will tenants request a backfill? UI + API? We should support both; API should return a job id and progress.

kevin: Implementation sketch:
```
POST /v1/audit/backfill { tenant_id, from_ts, to_ts, priority }
Response { job_id }
GET /v1/audit/backfill/{job_id} -> { status, bytes_exported, signature_url }
```
Backfill workers will read from cold store, reindex into new audit pipeline, and optionally generate export bundles.

alex: Good. Now constraints: SLA impact — high-volume backfills must be throttled to not affect realtime SLOs. Can we set default soft limit 25% of ingestion bandwidth per tenant and a hard system-wide cap?

kevin: Yes. We'll add circuit breaker that drops backfill bandwidth if ingest latency > target. Also add a prefixed cache check so duplicates aren't reprocessed.

maria: Launch criteria draft:
- Backfill API + job lifecycle implemented
- Export bundles produced with signed manifest (SHA256 + KMS signature)
- BYOK handshake docs + test vectors (rotation + escrow)
- Legal hold flags respected during export/backfill
- Load test demonstrating <x% impact to 99p ingest latency at peak

diane: Add SOC2 acceptance: evidence bundles must be verifiable offline (signature + cert chain), and key rotation events must be auditable in the control plane.

elaine-legal: Also require retention policies configurable per-tenant (min/max) and a playbook for evidence preservation for legal holds.

alex: Risks: escrow/escrowless asks from customers — some want shared escrow, others want full customer-only custody. We'll need two workflows and clear support boundaries.

sam: Ops burden increases if we support both. Suggest pilot with escrow option (our KMS) + BYOK as advanced enterprise feature.

kevin: Dependencies: logging/trace changes (to capture kms-audit-id), s3 export pipeline, quantized tests for reindex speed, and infra quota UI.

alex: Action items:
- Kevin: design backfill circuit breaker + job API (P0)
- Maria: draft export manifest spec + retention UI flows (P0)
- Diane: capture SOC2 acceptance criteria & add to PRD (P1)
- Elaine: provide legal hold playbook checklist (P1)
- Sam: mockups for admin UI + job monitor (P1)

kevin: I'll drop a short design doc in /docs and tag this thread. Expecting an initial API proto by EOW.

sre-bot: Reminder — create incident-runbook stub for long-running backfills that affect ingestion SLOs.

maria: One more thing — metrics: job_count, active_backfills, avg_backfill_throughput, backfill_latency_impact. Add alerting thresholds.

alex: Perfect. We'll reconvene Tues. If anyone has customer-specific constraints, drop them here or DM me. :thumbsup:
